description: This file defines the SessionActorQueue class, which manages queued asynchronous operations associated with session actor keys, utilizing an external KeyedAsyncQueue for queuing mechanisms and tracking pending operations per session.

classes.name: SessionActorQueue
classes.description: A class that manages a queue of asynchronous tasks keyed by session identifiers, providing methods to query queue status and execute tasks with tracking of pending operations.

methods.name: getTailMapForTesting
methods.description: Returns the internal tail map from the underlying KeyedAsyncQueue for testing purposes.

methods.name: getTotalPendingCount
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total number of pending operations across all sessions.

methods.name: getPendingCountForSession
methods.description: Returns the number of pending operations for a specific session key.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Enqueues and runs an asynchronous operation associated with a specific session key, updating pending counts accordingly.
